Name: FALL_CONTROL_PARAM_ST
Description: Air control while falling: horizontal acceleration along the direction of travel (negative values act as drag), vertical acceleration (gravity), steering acceleration and the maximum steering speed.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Acceleration
Fields.Description: Acceleration in m/s² along the character's horizontal direction of travel while airborne; negative values act as air drag and stop the character once they exceed its horizontal speed. Retail: -0.1 on most rows.

Fields.Name: Vertical Acceleration (Gravity)
Fields.Description: Vertical acceleration in m/s² while airborne (positive is up); negative values are the gravity of the jump or fall. Retail: -16.5 on the standard jump rows (100, 101), -35 on Executor's beast jumps, positive on two rising rows.

Fields.Name: Air Steering Acceleration
Fields.Description: How fast stick input (or aiming at a target) changes the horizontal velocity in the air, in m/s². Retail 1-30 (10 on most rows).

Fields.Name: Air Steering Max Speed
Fields.Description: Stick input in the air cannot push the horizontal speed above this, in m/s. Retail 1-30 (2 on most rows).
